statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the login(1) program (login-utils/login.c). This image builds util-linux with --disable-all-programs --enable-libuuid and ships only libuuid.so.1. The libuuid build stage fails if any object outside libuuid/ and its lib/ helpers is compiled, and tests/check_metadata.py fails if util-linux contributes any file other than libuuid.so.* or if a login binary is present.

The flaw is in the restricted (non-root) path of the mount(8) program and libmount's legacy mount(2) fallback (sys-utils/mount.c, libmount/). This image builds util-linux with --disable-all-programs --enable-libuuid and ships only libuuid.so.1; neither mount, umount nor libmount is compiled, and the distroless base ships none of them. The libuuid build stage fails if any object outside libuuid/ and its lib/ helpers is compiled, and tests/check_metadata.py fails if a mount or umount binary or a libmount library is present.
